originalTitle: Is Bloom Energy Stock's Drop A Chance To Buy?

content:
Most of Bloom Energy’s customers never own the power equipment they use. You probably expect the story to be AI data center demand, which is real. But demand is not what investors have missed. The shares fell 13.8% in three months as the S&P 500 rose 5.0%. So who does pay Bloom Energy (BE) for its equipment?

A Financier Usually Pays For Bloom Energy’s Equipment

A financier usually pays Bloom Energy, not the customer who uses the power. Management walked through how a deal works on the fiscal Q2 2026 call. A customer can buy the equipment outright. Most choose to pay over time instead, and never own it.

In those deals, Bloom Energy brings in an institution such as Brookfield. Brookfield buys the energy servers from Bloom Energy and owns them. It then supplies the customer under a contract Bloom Energy arranged. The next question is how much money the financiers have committed.

Brookfield expanded its commitment fivefold to $25 billion in June 2026. Management calls it a financial shelf: money available now, drawn on as fast as customers take up the funds. With that much money lined up, the three-month fall in the share price needs explaining.

Why Has The Share Price Fallen This Summer?

One cause is a dispute over scandium, a raw material in Bloom Energy’s supply chain. A securities class action alleges the company relied on scandium from China while its filings played down exposure to China. The suit says a July 8, 2026 report on that sourcing set off a fall in the share price.

On the fiscal Q2 2026 call, management said Bloom Energy is not dependent on China. Management added that it can see scandium supply for 25 gigawatts of deployments. The financing model does not settle this worry. Brookfield’s money can pay for servers, but it cannot supply a raw material.

Recent sales answer a separate worry, which is whether orders keep turning into sales. Product revenue was $935 million in fiscal Q2 2026, up 215% from a year earlier. Product sales made up nearly 90% of total revenue. Because most customers pay over time, many of those sales run through a financier.

Management then raised its fiscal 2026 revenue outlook to $3.9 billion to $4.2 billion. Management also said backlog, the orders not yet delivered, is growing faster than revenue. Strong sales still leave the question of what you pay for them.

You Pay Far More Per Dollar Of Profit

Even after the summer fall, you pay far more per dollar of profit here than for the S&P 500. The shares are still up 245% over 12 months . The P/E, or price-to-earnings ratio, is what you pay for each dollar of a year’s profit. Bloom Energy trades at 312.7 times earnings , against 22.4 for the S&P 500.

So the price appears to assume the sales growth runs for years. The Brookfield shelf is where that could break down, if customers are slow to draw on it. Management also said construction delays are normal and should be built into plans.

Management said its fiscal 2026 outlook does not depend on any single project. Watch whether management keeps the raised revenue range at the fiscal Q3 2026 report. A cut to that range would suggest orders are turning into sales more slowly than planned, from financing or construction delays.

chineseTitle: 布鲁姆能源股票的下跌是买入机会吗？
chineseSummary: Bloom Energy 的大多数客户从未拥有他们使用的电力设备。您可能认为这个故事是人工智能数据中心的需求，这是真实的。但投资者并没有错过需求。该股三个月内下跌 13.8%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 5.0%。那么谁为 Bloom Energy (BE) 的设备付费呢？
chineseContent:
Bloom Energy 的大多数客户从未拥有他们使用的电力设备。您可能认为这个故事是人工智能数据中心的需求，这是真实的。但投资者并没有错过需求。该股三个月内下跌 13.8%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 5.0%。那么谁向 Bloom Energy (BE) 支付其设备费用呢？

布鲁姆能源公司的设备通常由金融家支付费用

向 Bloom Energy 支付费用的通常是金融家，而不是使用电力的客户。管理层在 2026 年第二财季电话会议上详细介绍了交易的运作方式。客户可以直接购买设备。大多数人选择分期付款，而不是拥有它。

在这些交易中，布鲁姆能源公司引入了布鲁克菲尔德这样的机构。布鲁克菲尔德从 Bloom Energy 购买了能源服务器并拥有它们。然后，它根据 Bloom Energy 安排的合同向客户供货。下一个问题是金融家承诺了多少钱。

2026 年 6 月，布鲁克菲尔德将其承诺扩大了五倍，达到 250 亿美元。管理层将其称为财务货架：现在可用的资金，一旦客户使用资金就可以立即提取。有了这么多资金，股价三个月来的下跌需要解释。

为什么今年夏天股价下跌？

其中一个原因是关于钪的争端，钪是布鲁姆能源供应链中的一种原材料。一项证券集体诉讼指控该公司依赖来自中国的钪，而其备案文件淡化了对中国的敞口。该诉讼称，2026 年 7 月 8 日有关该采购的一份报告引发了股价下跌。

在 2026 年第二季度财报电话会议上，管理层表示 Bloom Energy 并不依赖中国。管理层补充说，它可以看到 25 吉瓦部署的钪供应。融资模式并不能解决这个担忧。布鲁克菲尔德的钱可以买服务器，但不能提供原材料。

最近的销售解决了另一个担忧，即订单是否持续转化为销售。 2026 财年第二季度产品收入为 9.35 亿美元，同比增长 215%。产品销售额占总收入的近90%。由于大多数客户会随着时间的推移付款，因此许多销售都是通过金融家进行的。

随后，管理层将 2026 财年收入预期上调至 39 亿至 42 亿美元。管理层还表示，积压订单（尚未交付的订单）的增长速度快于收入的增长速度。强劲的销售仍然留下了你为它们支付多少钱的问题。

您为每美元利润支付的费用要高得多

即使在夏季秋季之后，您在这里为每美元利润支付的费用也远远高于标准普尔 500 指数。该股在 12 个月内仍然上涨了 245%。 P/E，即市盈率，是您为一年的每一美元利润所支付的价格。 Bloom Energy 的市盈率为 312.7 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.4 倍。

因此，价格似乎假设销售增长持续多年。如果顾客拿货速度慢的话，布鲁克菲尔德的货架就可能会崩溃。管理层还表示，施工延误是正常现象，应纳入计划。

管理层表示，其 2026 财年前景并不取决于任何单一项目。关注管理层是否在 2026 年第三季度财报中维持提高的收入范围。削减到这一范围将表明，由于融资或施工延误，订单转化为销售的速度比计划慢。
